payload.title: M1 Map both chat stacks and design the package boundary
payload.description: Inventory what Papyrus's console chat does today (console-chat-responder, console-chat-enqueue, Slack events/delivery, where transcripts live, how tools are called) and what Chatticus provides (turn protocol: POST plus per-turn SSE with Last-Event-Id replay; durable turns; the agent loop; pull workers; the web UI kit already exported for Chattic.us-web). Decide what becomes a Chatticus package (server turn engine, stream protocol, client components), what stays in Papyrus (tools, auth, pane placement), and how Papyrus hosts it on AWS without an always-on cost floor. Record the design as a Papyrus doc.
